$Comment: The Turkey Graveyard's hard way in: the twin of Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard.json beside this file, with
the Great Turkey's hard fight in it. Every area of a copy pastes
Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Hard.prefab.json, the same graveyard with the hard fight's
entity, its hard spawn marker and a way-out pad in its entrance room (tools/arena_markers.py writes it from
tools/arenas/Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Hard.json), so every fresh paste stages a fresh hard fight.
EntryOffset lands an arriving party one block up, standing on the entrance room's floor, and EntryYaw 180
turns them to face south, into the graveyard. IntroCamera plays the Horseman's graveyard intro
(Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Intro), since every one of these graveyards shares one layout.
Martha the Cook opens it from her graveyard screen (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Host.json), and
only for a player who has finished and collected her quest The Great Turkey
(harvest_feast_great_turkey) this feast: that option's condition is the hard way's only gate, since this
file names no quest, so no other line or press-F may open it (a partymate who follows their party into an area it already holds walks in, as on the normal way). Season keeps it closed outside Harvest
Feast. Share: one party to an area, up to five players, and four areas to a copy. Complete names the hard
fight, the script its prefab runs, so the run clears when the Great Turkey falls, and Rewards rolls
Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Graveyard_Clear_Hard for each member present as a Claim: full the first hard clear
each day, half on later ones, counted apart from the normal clears. InChest puts that Claim in the chest
the Great Turkey leaves where it fell, beside its own two, with ChestKey's line under the clear's banner.
Difficulty files its runs and their returns under Hard, apart from the normal graveyard's. Text names it
in the reader's language (harvestfeast.progression.lang), and its GoalKey is the line each player reads
as they arrive.
EntryCost is the normal way's price, one Wishbone, taken from whoever opens an area for their party;
partymates who follow into that fight walk in free. Confirm is left out, so it is on: before anything is
spent, the player opening the area sees CommonLib's confirm screen with the hard graveyard's name and
description, the Wishbone, how many they hold and how many it takes. With none, the button is off and
the HintKey line says where Wishbones come from. Change Count to change the price, and Martha's hard
way-in label, which names it, with it.
